tasks.short: Mentor graduate students and junior colleagues

steps.what: Read the mentee's actual work and stated concerns
Mentor the actual graduate student or junior colleague through discussion

tasks.design: Keep mentoring with the astronomer, including separately counted reading of the mentee's actual work in {DOCS}. The existing shared work document provides context, but a template cannot replace personal reading or the mentoring discussion.
tasks.previous_blocker: The value is understanding this person's research and development needs.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing shared documents provide the relevant native access; no new labour-removing change is established.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising uncertainty, confidence and scientific-development needs in context.
tasks.human_edge: Offer trusted, specific advice and know when to challenge or support the mentee.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: research mentoring requires contextual reading and personal discussion; a separate progress record is not inherent to mentoring.

assumptions: Provisional shares cover an actual mentoring encounter with work reading, not formal institutional assessment. The mentee produces the work and concerns before s1; reading remains counted.

Before zero, record/write/lookup/send boundaries were inspected. The task establishes no mentor-owned progress log or outward recommendation. No trailing record is created. An actual required written review or recommendation must be separately added and assessed before confirming this estimate.
Native shared-document access is assessed first; this scenario already has direct access and no repeated navigation baseline. Fresh reading and live advice remain, so no template saving is assumed.
No implementation or recurring upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Any actual formal written mentoring requirement
research_questions: Observe mentoring and identify any real written review, lookup or send beyond the separately counted reading.

incremental.description: No new automation or recurring upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retain all 20 work-reading and 80 mentoring points. A new student's unfamiliar research requires full reading rather than a generic summary; no fictional progress log creates a saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review the student's astronomical research question, data and analysis specification
Repeat specified sandbox analysis runs and assemble comparison outputs
Interpret results and assess the student's methods and scientific claims
Discuss research findings and guide the student's next scientific work

tasks.design: Use the existing sandbox runner in {DATA_PLATFORM} to replay only reviewed, specified analysis and assemble comparison outputs. Keep data/code review, scientific interpretation and actual research guidance with the supervisor; no student grade or progress record is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Research reproduction can involve repeated manual launches and output gathering.
tasks.enabler_now: Native sandbox batching and reproducible run manifests.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the student's methods and conclusions are scientifically valid.
tasks.human_edge: Identify an apparently reproducible result whose scientific assumptions are wrong.
tasks.altitude: Less reproduction interaction, retaining scientific supervision.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: specified research runs can be replayed in a controlled environment while scientific assessment remains human.

assumptions: Provisional shares describe supervision that actually includes manual reproduction, not every research meeting. Existing unattended run time earns no saving; remove the baseline if reproduction is already automatic.

The student and observation pipeline produce data identifiers, calibration versions, units, source code and run parameters. s1 reviews these, selects exact runs and resolves missing metadata manually before s2. No ready validated dataset or reviewed code is assumed free.

Test native runners first. s2 removes manual launch/output gathering only, not code review, algorithm choice, scientific checking or student discussion. Unsupported runs remain manual in retained work or lower the estimate.
No trailing supervision diary is introduced; outputs are actual scientific comparison material used in s3/s4. Any formal written assessment requires a separately assessed boundary.
unknowns: Compatibility of student environments and observation formats
research_questions: Which launch and output-assembly interactions remain manual during a real supervision review?

incremental.description: Maintain sandbox run mappings and version checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20 reproduction-interaction points less 1.5 upkeep gives 18.5. A student using a different instrument calibration and environment needs manual repair, leaving only 4 points of compatible run/output assembly removable and 2.5 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Prepare actual astronomy explanations, examples and teaching visuals
Apply repeated lesson layout and place specified figure references
Check lesson material and teach actual astronomy or astrophysics students

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} lesson layouts for teacher-authored explanations and selected figures. Keep original teaching preparation, complete material checks and live instruction human, removing only repeated layout interactions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated formatting surrounds actual astronomy teaching preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native lesson styles and figure placement presets.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining difficult concepts and responding to students' actual reasoning.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a misconception and choose an explanation that helps this class.
tasks.altitude: Less lesson formatting, with teaching responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native lesson layouts can reuse formatting without generating astronomy content or teaching students.

assumptions: Provisional shares describe actual material preparation and teaching, not assessment or registry records. Existing automatic formatting earns no saving.
s1 produces the actual explanations, checked figure choices and references; course administration supplies the layout. Missing sources require manual preparation before s2.

Test native styles first. Five removed points are repeated layout only. Original pedagogy, complete pre-use material checking and live instruction remain. Ordinary file saves are retained within preparation.
The material check occurs at the start of s3 before teaching, without a record write hidden in the class. No new class-progress log or electronic publication is introduced.
unknowns: Actual repeated layout time after native styles
Proportion of teaching that needs new visuals
research_questions: Which material-formatting actions are still manual before the lesson?

incremental.description: Maintain lesson layouts and figure-reference presets

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 5 layout points less 0.5 upkeep gives 4.5. A new cosmology lesson requires bespoke visuals and arrangement, leaving only 1 point of reusable headings/reference placement and 0.5 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop theories from astronomical observations and prior theories

steps.what: Examine observations and prior astronomical theories and verify their comparability
Develop the theory and specify testable predictions and comparisons
Repeat specified numerical comparisons and assemble their outputs
Interpret comparisons and revise the actual theory and its limitations

tasks.design: Use the native run framework in {DATA_PLATFORM} for repeated comparisons whose equations, parameters and output measures the astronomer has already specified. Keep theory creation, observation comparability, scientific interpretation and the actual theory revision in {DOCS} human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated numerical run interaction and comparison-output assembly can interrupt theoretical work.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned deterministic run and output assembly.
tasks.still_hard: A scientifically useful theory and predictions that genuinely test it.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when observations contradict an assumption rather than merely adjusting a fit.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated numerical interaction, with theory development unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: specified numerical comparisons can be repeated deterministically without generating or validating an astronomical theory.

assumptions: Provisional shares describe theory development with actual repeated manual comparison interactions. Pure conceptual work and already unattended numerical work require reweighted graphs; computational runtime earns no saving.

Observation processes and prior publications supply data, units, calibration, uncertainty and source references. s1 includes obtaining and verifying them and any manual repair. s2 produces the actual equations, parameters and output specification before s3.
Native run frameworks are tested first. s3 removes repeated manual launch and output assembly only; all derivation, algorithm choice, interpretation and revisions remain.
s4 is the actual theory development output, not an added activity record. Its ordinary author save remains ungated. Publication or telescope commands are not included.
unknowns: Actual manual interaction around numerical work
Compatibility of observation metadata and theory inputs
research_questions: Separate existing numerical runtime from the astronomer's remaining manual comparison interactions.

incremental.description: Maintain prediction-run mappings and known-result checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20 repeated-interaction points less 1 upkeep gives 19. With observations from incompatible instruments, retain calibration repair and novel comparison work; only 5 points of compatible repeated outputs can be assembled, giving 4 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain theory, mentoring and teaching judgement while reducing actual repeated analysis or material-formatting interactions.
role.ambitious_version: Use verified recovered interaction time for scientific interpretation and direct student explanation.
